entries.strategyName: Order, invoice, and settle in one write
notes: Draft challenger aligned to the trusted 5-call exact-match path for Task 11.
Resolve payment type before invoicing and attempt settlement during PUT /order/{id}/:invoice.

NET-to-GROSS conversion added: receipt line prices are NET; strategy now computes actualGross = NET × (1 + vatRate/100) using statutory rate per expense category. For Togbillett: 8750 × 1.12 = 9800, vatType=12.
VAT rate inference already fixed: looksLikeTravel() checked before receipt text regex, so transport items get 12% regardless of receipt's blended 'MVA 25%' label.
Extraction notes updated to instruct LLM to pass receipt line price as-is without VAT multiplication.
BLOCKER: Sandbox verification cannot run — (1) packet has no proof.verificationPlan for task 22, (2) verifier hardcodes files:[] so requirePdfAttachment throws for attachment-dependent tasks.
Proof input file created at research/proofs/task-22/task-22-proof-input.json for future verification once the verifier supports file attachments.

Evidence base: production run 3373fbc9 (7/10, Check 3 failed on amountGross=10937.50/vatType=1 — should be 9800/vatType=12); RESEARCH.md sandbox-verified amountGross=9800 with vatType=12 produces correct NET=8750 and VAT=1050.
Manual disposable-fixture sandbox verification on 2026-03-21 proved the customer-payment branch end-to-end: a one-row CSV payment settled a real sandbox invoice from outstanding 1000 to 0.
The first manual sandbox attempt exposed a correctness bug: GET /supplierInvoice without invoiceDateFrom/invoiceDateTo returned 422. The current strategy now includes those required date bounds.

For the exact one-row incoming customer-payment shape, the challenger used 6 calls while the checked-in payment playbooks prove a 3-call lower bound: GET /invoice -> GET /invoice/paymentType -> PUT /invoice/{id}/:payment.
Supplier-payment and manual-voucher branches are not yet sandbox-verified.
